regions.name: Azure Haven
regions.description: Main tropical home region: sandy beaches, turquoise ocean, palm forests and the couple's beach house.

regions.name: Sunset Bay
regions.description: Romantic coastal region with a lighthouse, boardwalk, bonfire beach and the best sunset on the coast.

regions.name: Dreamfall Isles
regions.description: Fantasy floating islands: giant trees, glowing vegetation and waterfalls falling into the sky.

regions.name: Neon Abyss City
regions.description: Vertical cyberpunk megacity: neon streets, elevated roads, rooftops and an underground district.

regions.name: Nova Coast
regions.description: Futuristic tropical resort: glass villas, landing pads and an observation tower over ocean cliffs.

regions.name: Wildheart Highlands
regions.description: Mountainous wilderness: deep valleys, rivers, dense forests and high-altitude trails.

regions.name: Moonlight Forest
regions.description: Magical night forest: glowing plants, fireflies, a moonlit clearing and a hidden lake.

regions.name: Crystal Caverns
regions.description: Underground crystal network: glowing formations, underground lakes and puzzle chambers.

regions.name: Skyline Metropolis
regions.description: Modern premium city: shopping streets, rooftop restaurants, parks and a waterfront plaza.

regions.name: Coral Reef Archipelago
regions.description: Island-hopping ocean region: coral reefs, a shipwreck and underwater treasure.

regions.name: Frostpeak
regions.description: Snow mountain region: frozen lake, cozy cabins, ski slopes and northern lights nights.

regions.name: Golden Desert
regions.description: Large desert biome: rolling dunes, an oasis village, ancient ruins and a buried temple.

regions.name: Verdant Valley
regions.description: Peaceful countryside: farms, rivers, windmills and a sleepy village.

regions.name: Starlight Island
regions.description: Private luxury island: grand villa, infinity pool, yacht dock and starlit gardens.

regions.name: Sunken City
regions.description: Submerged exploration: drowned streets, underwater tunnels and hidden treasure rooms.

regions.name: Technova District
regions.description: Advanced technology zone: laboratories, robotics bays and elevated transport platforms.

regions.name: Rainbow Meadows
regions.description: Dreamy colorful landscape: flower fields, pastel streams and giant friendly trees.

regions.name: Lost Kingdom
regions.description: Adventure fantasy region: an ancient castle, broken bridges and underground chambers.

regions.name: Ocean Drive
regions.description: Coastal highway system: scenic roads, tunnels, bridges and service stations.

regions.name: Lumen City
regions.description: Bright futuristic city: garden towers, water features and a grand central plaza.

regions.name: Willow Lake
regions.description: Peaceful lake region: wooden docks, lazy boats, hidden island and camping shores.

regions.name: Volcanic Isle
regions.description: Volcanic adventure: black-sand beaches, lava caves, hot springs and an abandoned research station.

regions.name: Cloud Gardens
regions.description: High-altitude fantasy: floating garden platforms, temples above the clouds and sky bridges.

regions.name: Old Harbor
regions.description: Historic coastal town: cobbled streets, fish markets, warehouses and a proud old lighthouse.
